en.summary: Péter Magyar's government, formed after the April 2026 election, focuses on recovering frozen EU funds, fighting corruption and fixing public finances. Its first 2027 budget cuts income tax on the minimum wage to 9%, doubles family allowances and quadruples the minimum pension to HUF 120,000 a month. Health spending rises by HUF 510bn to HUF 4,604bn.

es.summary: El gobierno de Magyar, en funciones desde las elecciones de abril de 2026, prioriza la recuperación de los fondos de la UE congelados, la lucha contra la corrupción y la consolidación fiscal.
